GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down Off Mid-Field 7 Lengths Couldn'T Get Close heavy # lame

Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & improving 3 Wide @ 700m & Four Wide @ 600m. Improving Five Wide @ 500m & pushed to quicken on winner's outside Seven Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & sprinted with winner @ 200m. Had 8kg weight pull on winner but couldn't get past late. # Had his chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied passing the winning post on the first occasion when close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well settled Mid Field 2wide 5l held-up 500 - turn ran on very strongly # needed room sooner
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from the 500m to the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Settled Down Mid Field Outside 5-6l Quickly Improved from the 600 Straightened Up Narrow Leader Kept Going Too Well # ride won it
Jumped Fair Settled Down Worse than midfield 7l 3 Wide With Cover home turn 7l very Wide su, lays in flew last 100 raced clear # won going away
Jumped Ok Restrained Mid Field 5 Lengths 3 Wide mostly pushed wider Turn Kept Going Ok Closest # wide/sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover from the 900m. When questioned regarding the seemingly improved performance, trainer explained that the gelding had worked well in the lead-up to today's race and in his opinion was suited racing on the synthetic track surface for the first time.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Settled Down 6th With Cover 3l travelled well to Straightening Up but Quickly Battling weakened right out # didn't handle heavy

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward led 1 Lengths (winner Outside ) Beaten off Turn tired badly..vet-slow recovery # tired badly
